description:
Paired A/B experiments that test ONE script variable, the hook, with two variants (each a slug variantId such as hook-aggressive, never "A"/"B", with a name and the style you will follow when writing its hooks). create: define it. add_pair: both videos of one pair (same title, content and delivery, one hook per variant; each is a normal charged video, the second starts spacingHours after the first; the server rejects a pair that differs in anything but the hook, before charging; calling it again with the same arguments replays). list / results: results compare per network for a window (default 7d) with a sign-test pValue and a label: pending, indicative or clear. Never call a variant the winner unless the label is clear.
Actions and their required fields: create (name, variants); list (no required fields); add_pair (experimentId, pair, title, segments, hooks, description); results (experimentId).

accounts.description: Accounts to publish to, each an account name or id from accounts (the network is read from the account). Omit for the persona's bound publishing accounts.

action.description: What to do: create | list | add_pair | results. The description lists the fields each action needs.

description.description: Video description: the publish copy sent to the web route (one call is one video). Required — there is no fallback to the title.

hooks.description: One hook per variant. Only the hook differs inside a pair.

media.description: Photos for this segment. Each item is mediaId (from media (action: upload)) or url (a public image URL). One image per ~3s of speech (~8 words); a 60s video needs ~20 images, split across segments (max 30). Full lip sync: max 6 images total. Each photo shows while its share of the segment is spoken: full frame on faceless videos, or a framed panel (~38% of the frame) at the bottom, face still showing. Optional duration (0.5-6s): on-screen seconds for a full-frame photo; omit for the 2s default. Optional overlay: an info card (title, subtitle, badge), e.g. a place name, address and price; a spoken caption sits above it, never on the photo.

badge.description: Short highlight such as a price or a year, shown as a pill above the title.

subtitle.description: Address or area, shown under the title.

title.description: The real place name, shown large on the card.

text.description: This variant's hook, written following the variant description (25-40 words, ending with terminal punctuation).

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US.

mode.description: Publish mode: 'scheduled' (default) slots the video across startAt + times; 'asap' publishes it the moment generation finishes, with no scheduled time — do not set startAt or times.

name.description: Experiment name, e.g. "Calm vs aggressive hook".

options.description: Generation options applied to this video.

audioUrl.description: Public URL of custom audio for the videos (overrides the persona voice).

imageId.description: Library image ID to use for every video (overrides the deterministic per-video selection; see persona_media (action: list_images)).

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US. Overrides the persona when one is given.

musicMood.description: Background-music mood for the video: a mood from the engine BGM catalog, or "none" for explicit no music. Omitted lets the engine pick the first catalogued mood; an unknown mood is rejected with a 400 naming the valid moods. Works with faceless videos too.

niche.description: Content niche. Overrides the persona when one is given.

paragraphNumber.description: Paragraph count (1-10). Overrides the persona when one is given.

videoAspect.description: Frame shape. Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to 9:16.

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material (the agent images). Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to "standard". Same render cost either way.

videoType.description: The one video mode: full_lipsync = the whole video is the persona talking (requires a persona with a photo; 8 tokens at face quality ok, 15 at very_good); hook_lipsync = lip sync on the hook only, agent images after (requires a persona with a photo; 2 tokens ok, 3 very_good); faceless = agent images only, no face (persona optional — with one, its voice and niche still apply; 1 token). Required: the mode decides the render path and the price.

voiceId.description: Voice ID override: id or label from voices (action: list). Never type a provider prefix.

webhookUrl.description: Callback URL the server POSTs to when each video reaches a terminal state (completed/failed).

pair.description: Pair number: 1 for the first pair, then 2, 3... up to targetPairs.

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

pinterestBoardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to publish the pin to (the id from accounts (action: list_boards)). Required when pinterest is selected.

providers.description: Networks to publish to. Omit to use the networks of `accounts`, or of the persona's bound publishing accounts when `accounts` is omitted too.

segments.description: The shared script WITHOUT the hook: content takes only. Identical for both videos of the pair.

kind.description: Segment role: hook first, content after. Exactly one hook; a CTA is just a content take, placed anywhere.

media.description: Photos for this segment. Each item is mediaId (from media (action: upload)) or url (a public image URL). One image per ~3s of speech (~8 words); a 60s video needs ~20 images, split across segments (max 30). Full lip sync: max 6 images total. Each photo shows while its share of the segment is spoken: full frame on faceless videos, or a framed panel (~38% of the frame) at the bottom, face still showing. Optional duration (0.5-6s): on-screen seconds for a full-frame photo; omit for the 2s default. Optional overlay: an info card (title, subtitle, badge), e.g. a place name, address and price; a spoken caption sits above it, never on the photo.

badge.description: Short highlight such as a price or a year, shown as a pill above the title.

subtitle.description: Address or area, shown under the title.

title.description: The real place name, shown large on the card.

text.description: Spoken text only: no placeholders, links, markdown, emoji or stage directions.

spacingHours.description: Scheduled mode: the second video starts this many hours after the first (default 24 = next day, same time). Ignored in asap mode.

startAt.description: When the publish slot may start: ISO datetime. Required unless mode is 'asap'. The slot must be 3h-30d ahead.

targetPairs.description: Pairs to publish (each pair = 2 charged videos). The result can only be "clear" once all pairs are in; with 6 pairs one variant must win all 6, a moderate effect needs about 10-12.

times.description: Daily publish times in HH:MM 24-hour format. Required unless mode is 'asap'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a naive startAt and the HH:MM times, e.g. "Europe/Lisbon". Defaults to UTC.

title.description: Slot label for both videos (the pair topic).

variants.description: Exactly two variants of the hook.

description.description: The style rule you will follow when writing this variant's hooks, e.g. "direct, provocative, calls out a mistake".

variantId.description: Slug that identifies the variant in results and PostHog, e.g. hook-aggressive.

name: experiments
